In almost every year of the 1830s, a public source testified to a visionary event of Joseph Smith’s. The earliest accounts usually mentioned “an angel” when describing the discovery of the plates and the translation of the Book of Mormon (see Baugh, “Parting the Veil”).

SeeDoctrine and Covenants 27, as published in the 1835 edition of the Doctrine and Covenants. This revelation had appeared in the earlier Book of Commandments, but when Joseph prepared it for publication in the first edition of the Doctrine and Covenants, he expanded the text to include, among other things, Moroni (“Revelation, circa August 1835 [D&C 27],”Historical Introduction, josephsmithpapers.org).
